title: Cops Make Horrifying Discovery in Wisconsin Home
description:
Bodycam footage shows Milwaukee police making a horrifying discovery in the home of Romaun Moye. Moye's 12-year-old son was found in his home severely emaciated, with two broken arms and covered in maggots, according to police. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
